ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity substrate (black/dark grey) with high-intensity (white) point-clusters; estimated macro-level area ratio of approximately 1:12.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark field across both lobes containing a random high-frequency distribution of circular white geometric blobs. Higher density concentrations are observed at the distal tips of both left and right lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central indentation with an approximate 50-degree interior angle and a bounding-box depth of roughly 15% relative to the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous high-frequency, irregular serration along the entire trailing edge boundary; pixel-amplitude variations range from 3 to 15 pixels from the mean edge trajectory.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical outward sweep from the peduncle; interior edges of the notch exhibit slight convexity, while the overall lobe span follows a roughly linear path toward the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Extensive mapping of circular/annular high-intensity pixel clusters across the majority of the visible surface, with maximum spatial density located at the terminal points and along the trailing edge margin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy concentration of circular white scarring consistent with historical parasite/barnacle colonization; noticeable raggedness and minor tissue loss at the distal-most lateral tips.
